content.rationale: Recording is where D13's named purpose (rvyrosmp), D6's attribution (roqpxulw), D21's id refusal with its name and its excluded effects (tnqpoqxl, tsspuwzo, xtmprysl, qyynqqpx), the map-to-no-node rule (uzlvzrpv), the form's flag grammar (the path-less and unnameable-argument refusals and order-free recognition), the path that cannot be placed (R4), confinement (xklsyrrv), no birth (lypvkskv), O7-record's silence (wvqzoqvx), S3-status's changed set, S2-own's ownership rule and S3-place's mechanism meet; this check drives the handler over a scratch jj workspace whose node files are named by real change ids, and pins each of those, including a rename both of whose paths the target's ref covers placing as the one move, plus that the handler is the table's shape — a Verb row for it compiles (M-route). It reaches store_load through store_resolve, so it is a crate of its own. I1-serde (orrvsxqq) fixes the JSON layer the crate is written against — serde and serde_json, the crate's own `Value` and the derive — and I1-schema (zmmyomyp) fixes the validator these documents are checked with. It pins the read's refusal site (S2-read-refusal-site, vollyzvn): a target whose document cannot be read refuses, naming it.
